chapter.title: Getting Around
subtitle: Waystones, two compasses, and a map that draws itself as you walk.
Nothing in this valley is far once the first stone is standing.

hover: They come up mossy out east.

images.hover: Three to a craft. One trip each.
Goes to the nearest stone, wherever that is.
Never used up. Thirty seconds between trips.
Every scroll wants one of these.
Tied to one stone and no other.
Xaero draws his own. This one is for the wall.
Nella found hers in a wreck and said nothing.

quests.title: Craft a Waystone of Your Own
quests.subtitle: Eight stone bricks and one copper.
description: Craft a &aWaystone&r, set it down and right-click it to name it. From then on it is a place you can come back to.
&6Start Here&r puts the first one on the cottage hearthstone.

quests.title: Touch the Waystone in the Square
quests.subtitle: Oda did the lettering. Twice.
description: Walk to the town square at &b-302, -44&r and right-click the waystone by the well. Two stones make a route.
Warping between them costs no experience here.

quests.title: Warp Home From Your Inventory
quests.subtitle: One button, once every five minutes.
description: Open your inventory. The warp button lists every waystone you have touched. Pick one and you are standing at it.
It costs nothing. The wait is the whole price.

tasks.title: Warped once from the inventory button.

quests.title: Craft Three Warp Scrolls
quests.subtitle: Paper, gold, purple dye, one pearl.
description: Craft &aWarp Scrolls&r. Each one is a single trip to any waystone on your list, from wherever you are standing.
Three come off the bench at once.

quests.title: Keep Three Return Scrolls in the Bag
quests.subtitle: It goes to the nearest stone, not home.
description: Craft &aReturn Scrolls&r. One takes you to the closest waystone, so leave stones where you dig and the walk back is over.
No ender pearl in this one.

quests.title: Bind a Scroll to One Stone
quests.subtitle: After that it goes nowhere else.
description: Craft a &aBound Scroll&r, then sneak and right-click it on a waystone. Its tooltip names the stone it is tied to.
Bind it to the mill if you keep walking back to the mill.

quests.title: Cut a Warp Stone
quests.subtitle: Thirty seconds between trips.
description: Craft a &aWarp Stone&r from four amethyst shards, four ender pearls and an emerald. Hold right-click and pick a stone.
It is never used up. Only the cooldown stops you.

quests.title: Open the Map and Mark the Mill
quests.subtitle: The map fills in as you walk it.
description: Press &bM&r for the full map and &bO&r to drop a waypoint where you stand. Name the mill, the adit and the lake.
The minimap corner shows those marks from a long way off.

tasks.title: Three waypoints named on the map.

quests.title: Craft Nature's Compass
quests.subtitle: Ask it for a biome and it points.
description: Craft &aNature's Compass&r from a compass, logs and saplings. Right-click, pick a biome, and the needle holds that heading.
Use it when a crop wants a warmer season than this one.

quests.title: Craft the Explorer's Compass
quests.subtitle: Cobwebs. Take shears to a mineshaft.
description: Craft an &aExplorer's Compass&r from a compass, cracked stone bricks and cobwebs. It finds structures, not biomes.
Pick a tavern, a ruin, a village: see the &6Places&r chapter.

quests.title: Wear Something That Walks Faster
quests.subtitle: Nella found hers in a wreck. Said nothing.
description: Find an artifact and wear it. &aRunning Shoes&r, &aSnowshoes&r and &aAqua Dashers&r each turn a long walk into a short one.
They come out of chests underground: see &6Places&r.

tasks.title: One artifact worn in a trinket slot.

quests.title: Find the Savanna Village Waystone
quests.subtitle: North-west, about six hundred blocks.
description: Walk to the savanna village near &b-328, -504&r. The world stands its own waystones, one to a village, in the local stone.
Touch it and the walk home is one click.

rewards.title: The Road Is Short Now
rewards.description: Next: Act IV stands the Works Waystone on the plinth in the adit. Same block, deeper hole.
